frame: heliocentric, equatorial J2000 axes, Mpc, redshift distance v_LG / 70 (as 2mrs.bin)
note: Clusters: centred on the named galaxy, at the median v_LG of the 2MRS galaxies within 1.5 Mpc and 2,000 km/s of it. Voids and walls: approximate literature positions.

structures.name: Virgo Cluster
structures.source: Binggeli, Sandage & Tammann 1985, AJ 90, 1681; measured distance 16.5 Mpc from surface-brightness fluctuations (Mei et al. 2007, ApJ 655, 144)

structures.name: Fornax Cluster
structures.source: Ferguson 1989, AJ 98, 367; SBF distance 20.0 Mpc (Blakeslee et al. 2009, ApJ 694, 556)

structures.name: Perseus Cluster (Abell 426)
structures.source: Abell, Corwin & Olowin 1989, ApJS 70, 1; heart of the Perseus-Pisces supercluster (Haynes & Giovanelli 1986)

structures.name: Norma Cluster (Abell 3627)
structures.source: Kraan-Korteweg et al. 1996, Nature 379, 519: the core of the Great Attractor

structures.name: Coma Cluster (Abell 1656)
structures.source: Abell, Corwin & Olowin 1989; centre of the CfA2 Great Wall (Geller & Huchra 1989, Science 246, 897)

structures.name: Hercules Cluster (Abell 2151)
structures.source: Abell, Corwin & Olowin 1989; Hercules supercluster (Einasto et al. 2001)

structures.name: Shapley Supercluster core (Abell 3558)
structures.source: Shapley 1930; Raychaudhury 1989, Nature 342, 251; the largest concentration of mass within 200 Mpc

structures.name: Bootes Void
structures.source: Kirshner, Oemler, Schechter & Shectman 1981, ApJ 248, L57; Kirshner et al. 1987, ApJ 314, 493 (centre ~14h50m +46 deg, cz ~15,500 km/s, radius ~62/h Mpc)

structures.name: Sloan Great Wall
structures.source: Gott et al. 2005, ApJ 624, 463 (SDSS slice at Dec ~0, RA ~9h-15h, z ~0.07-0.08; 1.37 billion ly long)

structures.name: CfA2 Great Wall
structures.source: Geller & Huchra 1989, Science 246, 897 (RA ~8h-17h, Dec ~+27 to +40, cz ~5,000-10,000 km/s)
